8d5fe793-b41b-48c9-aef8-e3ffd9d1d4ab.title: Unauthorized card transactions: review and dispute procedure
8d5fe793-b41b-48c9-aef8-e3ffd9d1d4ab.content: An unfamiliar charge is reviewed first for household use and for cards saved in digital wallets or merchant accounts. A dispute is submitted by the customer through the secure dispute session, and only for a transaction the customer did not authorize. A posted charge is not erased outside the dispute process. Provisional credit is not guaranteed, and investigation timing depends on the transaction type. After submission the customer receives a claim reference and written timing disclosures in secure messages.

022398d3-51e3-4dcd-b56b-064d53b159f0.title: Dispute sessions: lifecycle and dispute rights
022398d3-51e3-4dcd-b56b-064d53b159f0.content: A dispute session is issued to the customer's secure message centre and completed by the customer in online banking. Issuing or opening a session does not create a claim; a claim exists only once the customer submits the form. A session that is closed or left unsubmitted ends without a claim and does not waive the customer's right to dispute that transaction or any other transaction later. A customer who later identifies a genuinely unauthorized transaction should contact the bank promptly.
